tasks.title: Hover time of a heavy vehicle
tasks.statement: A **{c} Ah** pack, hover current **{i} A**, we use 80 % of the capacity. Hover time (min)?
tasks.solution: t = 0.8·C / I · 60. For the course platform: 20 Ah, 56 A → ~17 min; the real time is shorter with maneuvering, wind and cold.

tasks.title: Thrust per motor after a failure
tasks.statement: An X8 with a mass of **{m} kg** has lost one motor. The average thrust on each of the remaining ones (g) to hover?
tasks.solution: The weight is shared by 7 motors instead of 8. In practice the failed motor's coaxial partner carries more than the average — check in the log that its output is not hitting the maximum.
